instructions: Slice the baguette into 1/2-inch pieces and lay them in one layer on a rimmed baking sheet. Brush the tops with 1 tbsp of the olive oil.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes, until the toasts are crisp and golden.

Meanwhile, put the olives, capers, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, oregano, 2 tbsp parsley leaves and the chopped basil in a food processor. Add a squeeze of lemon juice, the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil and a few grinds of pepper.
Pulse 15 to 17 times, scraping down the bowl a few times, until it's a chunky spread. Stop sooner for a coarser relish, or keep going for a smooth paste.
Transfer the tapenade to a small bowl. Serve with the warm baguette toasts.
Keep any leftover tapenade in a covered container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
method_notes: Vanilla & Bean's 10-minute tapenade leads (4.92 from 25 ratings): mixed olives, capers, sun-dried tomato, garlic, herbs, lemon and oil, with capers standing in for anchovy so it stays vegan. It is halved here to make about 1 cup for four. The baguette toasts (sliced, oiled, baked at 400°F) come from The Quicker Kitchen, since the lead only suggests baguette. Marisol Cooks also toasts the slices in a skillet.
